name: What factors determine the cost of repairing damaged drywall?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of repairing damaged drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall repair costs depend on the diameter of the damage, accessibility, texture matching, and whether repainting is included. Small nail holes and minor dings require basic patching, making them the most affordable. Larger breakthroughs, water damage, or ceiling repairs demand backing support, new drywall panels, multiple mud coats, and specialized texture blending like orange peel or knockdown. Because HH Remodeling handles both the underlying carpentry patching and the final paint finish directly, costs stay streamlined without needing separate painting subcontractors for small scopes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the damage size, ceiling vs. wall location, required backing, texture blending complexity, and whether final painting is included.
